data.gist: Nude rats (10–12/group) received intra-articular BMAX, BMAC, or PBS 4 weeks after DMM surgery; primary outcomes were knee-bend pain score and OARSI histology at 8 weeks.
data.plain: Adult female immunodeficient rats had osteoarthritis induced surgically (destabilization of the medial meniscus), then four weeks later were randomized to one of three injections into the joint. Pain behavior, swelling, histology and micro-CT were assessed at 4 and 8 weeks post-injection; group sizes were based on prior studies and feasibility rather than a formal power calculation, and no animals were excluded, though some analyses had slightly smaller samples due to technical issues.
